segments.oily: One reviewer with dehydrated but oily/combination, acne/congestion-prone skin says the serum absorbs without feeling greasy and reduces redness even in humid weather.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry (including dry sensitive) skin describe the serum as hydrating and non-sticky, with skin feeling supple, soft, and "drinking it up."
segments.combination: The one combination-skin reviewer (also oily/dehydrated/acne-prone) reports good hydration without greasiness and reduced redness.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers, including those with rosacea, eczema, or perioral dermatitis, report no irritation and improved comfort, but two report small white pimples/breakouts after use.
segments.normal: A reviewer describing her skin as having "great skin texture and tone" reported a bad breakout of small white blister-like pimples.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s, 50s, and 60s report smoother texture, plumper and bouncier skin, softer fine lines, and brighter tone with continued use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report smoother, plumper, firmer skin and softer fine lines (forehead, under-eye, around nose/mouth) after several weeks; some note it's too early to judge anti-aging effects and one with no deep wrinkles saw little dramatic change.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers, including those with dry or dehydrated skin, describe the serum as hydrating and moisture-boosting, with some saying they could skip their moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or perioral dermatitis report no flare-ups and reduced redness; one reviewer specifically notes redness reduced after regular use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers using it alongside barrier-repair creams or after retinol/tret report good tolerance and no added irritation, though one reviewer needed a barrier cream first to tolerate actives well.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading of hyperpigmentation, dark spots, melasma, and acne marks within weeks; one reviewer with no intense hyperpigmentation saw no notable change in tone.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts even after months of use; however, at least three reviewers describe new small white pimples or blister-like breakouts attributed to the serum.
concerns.oiliness: The one reviewer with oily/combination skin reports the serum is absorbed without greasiness and does not add oiliness despite hot, humid conditions.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under makeup and other products

extraits.titre: My skin was not a fan
extraits.texte: I received this item as a gift for an honest review from GlossAngeles. Sadly my skin was not a fan of this product- within a week of use my skin broke out terribly in small white like blister pimples. I am in my (almost) mid 40s with a great skin texture and tone- love trying new product. I continued use for another week thinking it was a purge but they continued. Beautiful jar but not the product for my skin.

Not gonna lie, its an expensive bottle. But my skin loves this so much its earned a permanent place in my routine. It has a slightly oily but watery texture that spreads beautifully. I have dehydrated but oily/combination skin that is acne/congestion prone. Even in hot, swampy humid MN summer my oily skin drinks this in and the next morning my skin looks *healthy* and that coveted glow from within, not greasy, not glass skin. Just really healthy and happy, redness reduced, hydrated, even toned skin. Each time I use it there is a slight skin tingle (no burn) I assume from all the wonderful actives. It layers very well with the rest of my routine AND a little goes a long way. Ive been ising this nearly nightly for 7 weeks and I'm not even halfway through the bottle yet. This one has earned its permanent place.

I'm a long time Bloom Effects fan and therefore am not surprised this formula works well with my dry and sensitive skin. I have eczema and rosacea that is easily flared with new products but yet again, this BR product is hydrating and has caused zero irritation. Look forward to the long term benefits.

After using this serum for some time I can appreciate that it's a beautiful formula, while it might not exactly work for me!! I have very sensitive skin, and I got some small white pimples after using this. However I think that's just my skin, and my overall experience with the serum otherwise was very positive. The bottle is chic and feels expensive, the serum is light and glides on well over a toner or a light spritz of water. I was gifted this serum through Gloss Angeles, so I will be passing it to a friend to try since it's not for me!

At 41, with sensitive skin prone to rosacea breakouts, I'm constantly searching for products that will make my skin look fresh and minimize fine lines without triggering a breakout. After 10 days of use, I'm seeing a noticiable difference in my overall complexion… the glow is real - and the lines around my nose aren't as prominent. No flare ups either as this product is gentle but effective. YAY!

As part of the Gloss Angeles Confidential testers, I tested this project for about 1 month and I LOVED it! The product did deliver on its claims. I had a few surprising breakouts from my makeup brushes that had left a few marks. Within the testing month, the scars faded by about 90%. Additionally, just in the first few days of using the serum, I felt that the serum gave me a specific glow. The viscosity of the serum lead to a great experience in being able to massage the serum into my skin. I think this serum is an all in one option! You honestly don't need any other actives in your skincare routine if you would use. I highly recommend and would buy again. Especially for my mom!

extraits.titre: Hydrating and ok for sensitized skin
extraits.texte: I am late 30s, dry sensitive skin. My skin has also been pretty sensitized lately by tret. This is surprisingly nourishing and hydrating. I use with educated mess freeze frame over it and love the feeling. My skin feels so hydrated. I look forward to continue to use and now will purchase more on my wishlist from Bloom Effects!
